note: Hand corrections of OpenStreetMap building footprints, applied by world_data.py. 'polygon' replaces the footprint (world metres: x east, y north, counter-clockwise). Always say why.

w496301638.name: CTT Student Hall
w496301638.why: OSM draws two thin arms west of the roof terrace. The walk video (IMG_7723, 0-25 s) shows they are the ramps down to the lawn, not storeys. Trimmed so the jump off the terrace edge lands on open ground instead of a 3.4 m slot between two walls (decided 2026-11-08). The ramps can come back as low props outside the landing zone.

w496301632.name: Biblioteca Teresa e Alexandre Soares dos Santos
w496301632.why: V10i: OSM draws the roof outline, which includes the bridge at the north-west end. The ground floor is the south wing and the north block east of the passage (campus survey V10h 4.4, plaza_plan.LIB_GROUND): the race line runs through the passage under the bridge at plaza level. env_library.py builds the bridge above it. world_data.json was patched for this building only (same result as world_data.py gives for it).
w496301632.route_base_why: The OSM outline. route_from_sketch.py runs Noah's waypoint pipeline against it (the old line was pushed off this outline), so every point outside the V10i section stays where it was; the section override then uses the corrected ground-floor polygon.
